name: Mention → Enrich Author → Google Sheet Lead List

parameters.content:
## 2 · Mention → Enrich Author → Google Sheet

**What it does:** Every new mention of your brand/topic gets its author resolved to a real person (title, company, verified email, social links) and appended as a lead row in Google Sheets.

**Setup**
1. **New Mention** → set *Topic*.
2. **Enrich Author** → no config needed; it reads the author from the mention.
3. **Append Lead Row** → pick your Sheet + tab and map columns.

**Credentials & key**
- Mention scan → **MentionFox connection token** (mentionfox.com/connect).
- **Enrich Author** → your **FoxAPIs API key** (`fxp_live_…`) from **foxapis.com**. Spends **FoxAPIs credits**, not a MentionFox connection token.

**Credit cost per mention:** scan 3 cr/source + enrich **100 cr (Light)** / 150 cr (Deep). Enrich returns `found:false` cheaply when the author can't be resolved.

Pricing: https://mentionfox.com/pricing

nodes.name: New Mention
nodes.notes: Emits each new, deduped mention. Uses the MentionFox connection token.

nodes.name: Enrich Author
nodes.notes: POST /v1/enrich_person — resolves the mention author to a verified contact. FoxAPIs API key. 100 cr Light / 150 cr Deep.

nodes.name: Append Lead Row
nodes.notes: Appends the enriched author as a lead row. Pick your destination Sheet + tab.
